title: draft_package v0
description: DRAFT v0. The one file that moves between David (reads and prepares) and the Demo Bistro app / the manager (approves and writes). Version 0 is David's side of the contract; it is finalised with the app's own session before any pipeline code depends on it.

draft_id.description: DRAFT-<business_day>-<nnn>. Carried on every row written from this draft, so a draft can be undone as a whole.

day_status.description: A draft may only target an open day.

correction_reason.description: Required when day_status is ended (the app's correction mode asks for a reason).

rate_lbp_per_usd.description: The rate in use for this day (set by head office).

extraction.description: What the reading step saw. Every number carries a confidence and whether two independent readings agreed. Unreadable values are null, never guessed.

amounts_printed.description: false when the POS roll prints a quantity per item and no price (the real Summary By Items), so a line has no amount and the lines cannot be totalled. Absent means true.

actual_cash_count.description: Optional. ONE grand total of all cash counted (registers + safe), USD: the app's 'New'. When given it is the count; counted_usd / counted_lbp are then the register notes only.

computed.description: Produced by code (reconcile_cash and friends), never by a model.

tolerances.description: From reference/tolerances.md, set by the manager. Null means none configured.
